injection_scenarios.compact_10NN_region: same positive z shift injected into the 10 optical nearest neighbours of a random center
injection_scenarios.smooth_local_region: Gaussian-decaying positive z shift around a random optical-phenotype center
injection_scenarios.broad_PC1_upper_tail: positive z shift injected into upper 20% of PC1
injection_scenarios.exact_IcBL_subtype: positive z shift injected into all secure SN Ic-BL objects

decision.secondary_confirmatory: max over predefined spectroscopic subtype stack scores
decision.reason: The tests have complementary power. kNN10 is strongest for compact unknown phenotype regions; linear PC trend is strongest for broad smooth manifold trends; subtype stacking is strongest only when the true signal follows an existing subtype label.
